headline: Autumn auction activity cools as winter season develops
caption: East Auckland property market update: Fewer homes are coming to auction as we head into winter, though those that do are still selling at a steady pace. If you're thinking of selling, it's worth having a chat about your timing and strategy—the cooler season can actually work in your favour with the right approach! 🏡
original_title: Residential auction activity cools off further in the back end of April
